page.overview:
Who is Karen?

Karen is a -type Pokémon user and is one of the members of Johto Elite Four.

Karen is a slim young woman who has silvery-blue eyes and long wavy silvery-blue hair with a centre parting that reaches past her waist with two long bangs that frame her face.

She wears a short spaghetti strap black dress with a V neckline edged with purple zig-zag pattern on the neckline and skirt hem, and black flats on her feet.

Karen's appearance remains the same as it is in Gold and Silver.
